from pathlib import Path
import runpy
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u047/system/state/workspace/programs')

ns=runpy.run_path(str(task_file))
transform=ns['transform']
demo_in=[[6,5,5],[5,1,7],[4,5,2]]
demo_out=[[6,6,5,5,5],[6,6,5,5,5],[5,5,1,7,7],[4,4,5,2,2],[4,4,5,2,2]]
test=[[1,2,5],[7,3,6],[7,6,5]]
print(transform(demo_in)==demo_out)
print(transform(test))
